items.prompt: Swarthmore College maintains an ongoing commitment of building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive residential community dedicated to rigorous intellectual inquiry. All who engage in our community are empowered through the open exchange of ideas guided by equity and social responsibility to thrive and contribute as bridge builders within global communities. Our identities and perspectives are supported and developed by our immediate contexts and lived experiences - in our neighborhoods, families, classrooms, communities of faith, and more. What aspects of your self-identity or personal background are most significant to you? Reflecting on the elements of your home, school, or other communities that have shaped your life, explain how you have grown in your ability to navigate differences when engaging with others, or demonstrated your ability to collaborate in communities other than your own.
items.ru: Первый короткий ответ Swarthmore: что в вашей личности или опыте важнее всего и как вы научились работать с различиями. До 250 слов.
items.evidence: As part of the Common Application and Coalition Application, you will be asked to submit no more than 250 words in response to each short answer question

items.prompt: Swarthmore's community of learners inspire one another through their collaborative and flexible approach to learning. Swarthmore students are comfortable with intellectual experimentation and connection of ideas across the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and interdisciplinary studies through a liberal arts education. Tell us about a topic that has fascinated you recently - either inside or outside of the classroom. What made you curious about this? Has this topic connected across other areas of your interests? How has this experience shaped you and what encourages you to keep exploring?
items.ru: Второй короткий ответ Swarthmore: какая тема вас недавно увлекла и почему. До 250 слов.
items.evidence: As part of the Common Application and Coalition Application, you will be asked to submit no more than 250 words in response to each short answer question

items.ru: Две рекомендации от учителей академических предметов.
Иностранным ученикам нужно одно из трёх: видео-ответ Swarthmore, результат экзамена по английскому или видео InitialView.
items.evidence: Applicants attending school outside the U.S., regardless of citizenship, are required to submit one of the following : Swarthmore Video Response, English Proficiency Exam Result, or an Initialview Video.

items.ru: Интервью по желанию; кто его не прошёл, не получает преимущества или штрафа.
items.evidence: Swarthmore offers optional interviews . Please note that applicants who do not interview are not at a disadvantage.

items.ru: По желанию можно показать работы по искусству: творческое письмо, танец, музыку, театр или изобразительное искусство.
items.evidence: Students with especially strong backgrounds and interest in pursuing the arts at Swarthmore can share samples of their work free of charge. We accept supplements in creative writing (written or spoken word poetry and fiction), dance (performance and choreography), music (performance and composition), theater, and the visual arts.

items.ru: По желанию можно загрузить резюме и другие дополнительные материалы о себе.
items.evidence: Additional materials that you feel are important to understanding who you are (such as resumes, research abstracts, Schoolhouse.world portfolios, or other items) can be uploaded in your portal after you submit your application.

items.ru: Награду или достижение можно показать, загрузив фото с кратким описанием в портал.
items.evidence: If you want to highlight an award or other achievement, instead of mailing it to Swarthmore, you can upload a photo along with a brief description to your applicant portal.

note: Общее эссе и список активностей Common App общие, не внесены. Видео-ответ можно также по желанию всем ученикам, не только иностранным.
